name: Sika® Injection-111 C
tagline: Catalyst designed for use with Sika® Injection 111
summary: Sika® Injection-111 C is the catalyst designed for use with Sika® Injection 111.
metaDescription: Sika® Injection-111 C is the catalyst designed for use with Sika® Injection 111.
attributes: Easy to pour/mix into Sika® Injection 111
usage: Sika® Injection-111 C is only to be used only in conjunction with Sika® Injection 111 to adjust the reaction time depending on the desired outcome.
advantages: Easy to pour/mix into Sika® Injection 111

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: From date of production if stored properly in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5°C and +30°C.

items.label: Mixing ratio
items.text: Sika® Injection-111 requires the catalyst Sika® Injection-111C to create a reactive foam for injection. Typical mix ratios vary from 2-10% of the Sika® Injection-111C depending on the reaction time required, please refer to the reaction table on this PDS for the information.

items.label: Reaction time
items.text:
Reaction time at 5°C
Sika Injection-111C (Catalyst) | Start time | End time
2% addition | 1min | 5min 38 sec
6% addition | 30 sec | 3min 25 sec
10% addition | 23 sec | 2min 33 sec
Reaction time at 15°C
Sika Injection-111C (Catalyst) | Start time | End time
2% addition | 51 sec | 5min 6 sec
6% addition | 23 sec | 2min 54 sec
10% addition | 18 sec | 2min
Reaction time at 25°C
Sika Injection-111C (Catalyst) | Start time | End time
2% addition | 35 sec | 4min
6% addition | 18 sec | 2min 40 sec
10% addition | 16 sec | 1min 41 sec

items.label: MIXING
items.text: Sika® Injection-111 should be mixed with Sika® Injection-111C using a paddle drill mixer to create a uniform homogeneous liquid for a minimum of 20-30 seconds.

items.label: CLEANING OF EQUIPMENT
items.text: Please consult equipment/pump manufacturer for relative cleaning agent suitable for your individual equipment being used.
